hypotheses.E1_lopo_family_transfers: A family set formed without the query lexical pair reaches at least 0.15 median downstream fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.E2_lopo_family_beats_random: Leave-one-pair-out family fidelity exceeds fixed random-256 fidelity by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.E3_lopo_family_beats_median_wrong_family: Leave-one-pair-out correct-family fidelity exceeds the per-query median of every wrong-family set by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.E4_lopo_family_beats_best_wrong_family: Leave-one-pair-out correct-family fidelity exceeds the best wrong-family set per query in median on both corpora.
hypotheses.E5_lopo_family_beats_lopo_global: Leave-one-pair-out family fidelity exceeds a leave-one-pair-out global set by at least 0.03 on both corpora.
hypotheses.E6_lopo_family_transfers_ood: TinyStories leave-one-pair-out family fidelity retains at least 75% of FineWeb fidelity.
hypotheses.E7_lopo_support_is_nonrandom: Leave-one-pair-out family/oracle Jaccard exceeds random/oracle Jaccard by at least 0.03 on both corpora.
hypotheses.E8_same_pair_leakage_is_limited: Removing the same lexical pair from family discovery lowers downstream fidelity by at most 0.10 on both corpora.
